gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i2: Tests for the {@link SparseBloomFilter}.
DELETED o3: verify exit early before bitmap boundary
DELETED o4: verify exit early at bitmap boundary
DELETED o5: verify add extra if all values in first bitmap
DELETED o6: verify exit early if all values in first bitmap and predicate returns false on 2nd block
ADDED i3: Indices that span both bitmap longs: 1-9 fall in long[0], 65-71 fall in long[1]. Used to exercise the multi-bitmap code path in {@code processBitMaps}.
ADDED i4: Indices that all fall within long[0], leaving long[1] as an all-zero trailing block. Used to verify that {@code processBitMaps} emits the mandatory trailing zer
ADDED i5: Verifies that {@code processBitMaps} stops immediately when the predicate returns {@code false} on the very first bitmap block, and that exactly one block was v
ADDED i6: Verifies that {@code processBitMaps} stops at the bitmap-block boundary when the predicate returns {@code false} after accepting the first block. Exactly one in
ADDED i7: Verifies that when all set bits fall within long[0], {@code processBitMaps} still delivers the required trailing all-zero block for long[1], for a total of two
ADDED i8: Verifies that when all set bits fall within long[0] and the predicate rejects the trailing zero block, {@code processBitMaps} returns {@code false} after exactl
ADDED i9: Verifies that merging a non-sparse {@link SimpleBloomFilter} into a sparse filter produces a result with identical bitmap contents to the source filter.
